include_patterns.description: List of regular expressions (strings) for --include; matches are done against whole path; multiple allowed. If empty, no include filter is applied (i.e., all files included).

exclude_patterns.description: List of regular expressions (strings) for --exclude; applied after include matches.

verbose_level.description: Numeric verbosity LEVEL for --verbose. Higher values produce more informational messages.

dir_only.description: If true, apply --dir to display only directories.

no_exclude_vcs.description: If true, apply --no-exclude-vcs to prevent exclusion of version control directories (e.g., .git).

exclude_vcs.description: If false, apply --exclude-vcs to explicitly disable VCS exclusion (rarely needed; --no-exclude-vcs takes precedence).
